A couple of kids from my high school got into Yale - a Roma girl and a Native American girl. The Roma student was the class president, an honor roll student, and had multiple letters of recommendation, whereas the selection of the Native American student came as a bit of a surprise. Who was likely selected due to diversity considerations rather than on merit alone?
A. The Native American student
B. The Roma student
C. Can't be determined
